videos.headline: Heupel spreads credit for impressive UT Orange Bowl win
videos.description: Josh Heupel credits the play of QB Joe Milton III, the presence of injured QB Hendon Hooker, and his defense for No. 6 Tennessee's 31-14 romp over No. 6 Clemson.
